Templar.tooltip: Sweep your blade through the soot-choked air, igniting the blood of the unworthy.
Templar.sound_cue: Heavy scraping iron followed by the guttural roar of ignited furnace flames.

Templar.tooltip: Call upon the charred bones of the ancient Saints to form a bulwark of hardened ash.
Templar.sound_cue: A resonant, rusted bell toll accompanied by the grinding of heavy stone slabs.

Templar.tooltip: Crash from the heavens like a dying star, crushing heretics beneath holy, molten iron.
Templar.sound_cue: Deafening metallic crash shattering instantly into a crackling bonfire.

Cleric.tooltip: Offer your own vitality to stitch the wounds of an ally with threads of warm crimson.
Cleric.sound_cue: Wet, tearing flesh giving way to a soft, deeply echoing heartbeat.

Cleric.tooltip: Desecrate the soil, causing pale ethereal hands to grasp at the ankles of trespassers.
Cleric.sound_cue: Low, mournful choral whispers layered over the sound of cracking permafrost.

Cleric.tooltip: Unleash a silent scream that knits shattered bone and purges the taint from the devout.
Cleric.sound_cue: A dissonant vocal choir abruptly resolving into a sudden, vacuum-like silence.

Spellblade.tooltip: Pierce the veil of reality, driving a rapier of condensed void into the enemy's soul.
Spellblade.sound_cue: High-pitched crystalline tearing ending in a deep, concussive sub-bass thud.

Spellblade.tooltip: Step into the grey spaces between moments to deflect a fatal blow and sever the attacker's shadow.
Spellblade.sound_cue: Sharp glass shattering instantly muted by a rushing, otherworldly wind.

Spellblade.tooltip: Unleash a storm of astral steel, briefly eclipsing the battlefield in absolute, suffocating darkness.
Spellblade.sound_cue: Rapid, overlapping scythe swoops concluding with a sharp, piercing chime.
